info.name: Grounded Card Agent
info.description: Every endpoint of the local API. POSTs send Idempotency-Key: {{$guid}}. Q&A for each request: interview_prep/INTERVIEW_QA.md (local).

item.name: 01 Health
item.description: No auth, no Idempotency-Key. Run these first.

item.name: Health (liveness)
item.description: Process is up.

item.name: Ready (Postgres, Chroma, corpus, prompt, LLM chain)
item.description: 200 only when Postgres + ChromaDB are reachable, the corpus is ingested and the prompt loaded. Also lists the configured LLM chain (Gemini -> Groq/Grok).

item.name: 02 Chat - the six required demo scenarios
item.description: POST /chat with a new Idempotency-Key each send.

item.name: EV-001 Answer with account figures (fee waiver)
item.description: Account fact (card-year spend 1,62,000) vs policy fact (Signature waiver at 4,00,000), both cited.

item.name: EV-002 Decline with approved reason code
item.description: Open dispute -> deterministic rules decline with AA04, citing POL-CRD-001.

item.name: EV-007 Raise a service request (dispute)
item.description: Unrecognised transaction -> DISPUTES queue; request_id and SLA come from the tool, not the model.

item.name: EV-010 Coverage gap -> honest refusal + routed
item.description: Not in the corpus -> retrieval gate says not grounded -> no guessing, GENERAL queue.

item.name: EV-012 Prompt injection via quarantined doc
item.description: POL-OPS-012 was quarantined at ingest; input guard flags the request; validator forces 'refused'.

item.name: Forced tool timeout -> degraded, no guessing
item.description: Start the server with TOOL_FAIL_RATE=1 to see the degraded path; with the default 1/12 it usually answers.

item.name: 03 Chat - guardrails and edge cases
item.description: Entry and exit guardrails in action.

item.name: Internal score request -> refuse + offer reason codes
item.description: Score never leaves the server (redacted before the model; output guard blocks the number).

item.name: Cross-customer request -> refused
item.description: customer_id is bound from the request; another customer's id in the text forces a refusal.

item.name: System prompt extraction -> refused
item.description: Injection flag + output guard prompt-leak check.

item.name: Vulnerable customer asks for offers -> no sales
item.description: POL-CON-004: no sales content, and the flag itself is never disclosed.

item.name: PII in the message is masked before the model sees it
item.description: Entry guard masks card/Aadhaar/PAN/email/phone/OTP -> meta.flags contains pii_masked.

item.name: Policy conflict D1 (3 vs 6 months)
item.description: POL-CRD-011 says 3 months, POL-CRD-001 says 6: the prevailing doc is cited.

item.name: Follow-up in the same conversation
item.description: Uses {{conversationId}} saved by the previous chat request (same customer).

item.name: Chat stream (Server-Sent Events)
item.description: Stage events stream live; claims are released only after validation (buffer-then-release). Postman shows the raw event stream.

item.name: 04 Idempotency-Key
item.description: Every POST must carry Idempotency-Key. Run 1/2 then 2/2.

item.name: Replay 1/2 - first send (stored)
item.description: Generates a key, stores the response.

item.name: Replay 2/2 - same key + same body -> stored response
item.description: Same key, same body: the agent is NOT run again. Header Idempotent-Replayed: true, identical body.

exec: pm.test('same body (stored as jsonb: same data, key order may differ)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('replayBody'))));

item.name: Same key + different body -> 422
item.description: A key names one operation; reusing it for another is rejected.

item.name: Missing Idempotency-Key -> 400
item.description: Rejected before auth or the agent runs.

item.name: 05 Errors
item.description: The safe error envelope: {error: {code, message, request_id}} - never a stack trace.

item.name: Unknown customer -> 404
item.description: CustomerNotFound from the tool -> 404, even in static mode; no service request is raised.

item.name: Invalid body -> 400 with field names
item.description: customer_id must match CUST-dddd; message 1-1000 chars.

item.name: 06 Retrieval (debug)
item.description: Hybrid search with per-leg scores: BM25 (kw) + vector (vec) fused by RRF.

item.name: Search - miss (travel insurance)
item.description: Below the relevance gate -> grounded=false, near misses shown.

item.name: Search - conflict note D1
item.description: CRD-011 retrieved -> the prevailing CRD-001 chunk + note are attached.

item.name: 07 Observability (req_res_log)
item.description: One Postgres row per API call: source, response time, model, tokens, failures.

item.name: API calls (latest)
item.description: One row per call, keyed by its Idempotency-Key: source (postman/curl/x-client-source), response_time_ms, provider + model, llm_failures + models_failed, tokens, cost, cache_hit, replay_count.

item.name: API calls - only chat, only Groq
API calls - with a flag
item.description: Flags: fallback_used, citation_repair, retrieval_miss, static_mode, pii_masked, cache_hit_exact, ...

item.name: Usage + model health summary
item.description: usage_by_source (calls, tokens, cost, avg response time, cache hits) · llm_attempts_by_model (attempts, failure %, error types) · answer_quality_by_model (repairs, degraded, guard blocks) · calls_by_status_code.

item.name: One call in full (request, response, LLM attempts, spans)
item.description: lastRequestId = x-request-id of the last chat call (its Idempotency-Key). A trace_id works too.

item.name: 08 Prompts
item.description: Versioned prompt files; the active version + sha is stamped on every trace.

item.name: 09 Admin (admin key)
item.description: Corpus ingestion into ChromaDB and a look inside the vector store.

item.name: Ingest run history (ingest_log)
item.description: One line per run: ingested / skipped / quarantined / failed.

exec: const r = pm.response.json().runs; if (r.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('ingestRunId', r[0].run_id);

item.name: Ingest run - per document
item.description: One ingest_log row per document.

item.name: Vector store contents (ChromaDB)
item.description: Both collections: ids, metadata, embedding dimension + preview, text preview.

item.name: 10 Semantic cache (semantic_cache)
item.description: Account-independent answers reused without the LLM. Run in order.

item.name: Cache 1/3 - first ask (LLM answers, answer stored)
item.description: Account-independent + validated + no repair -> stored in semantic_cache (see admin cache stats).

item.name: Cache 2/3 - another customer, same question (no LLM)
item.description: Exact hit (punctuation / number format ignored): meta.cache_hit=true, llm_calls=0, ~0.4 s.

item.name: Cache 3/3 - different number (must NOT hit)
item.description: Embeddings ~0.99 similar, but the numbers differ, so the cached answer is not reused.

item.name: Cache stats
item.description: Entries, hits, threshold, TTL, top entries.

item.name: Clear cache
item.description: Deletes every semantic_cache row.

item.name: 11 Eval
item.description: Runs eval cases through the real agent (slow: one LLM conversation per case).

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.run_id) pm.collectionVariables.set('evalRunId', j.run_id);
